name: tali-dash-plugins
description: DSH plugins, recipes and deployment tooling. Scripts: dev-overlay (write cordis.dev.local.yml with this checkout's absolute paths from the committed cordis.dev.yml template); bootstrap (fresh-machine installer, tools/bootstrap-mac.sh); bootstrap-remote user@host [flags] (same, over ssh; an existing DSH there is taken over by default, --no-replace refuses); bootstrap-thin-client [HOST [USER]] (tools/bootstrap-mac-thin-client.sh: only the blue Dock app to a remote DSH, no local build); uninstall-dsh [--force] (tools/uninstall-mac.sh: stop, unload, trash everything DSH on this Mac; keeps ~/.dsh and the checkouts); remote-app <host[/path]> [--name N] (blue Dock app straight to a remote DSH); install-plugins / remove-plugins [--profile web] (all live plugins as bundles); deploy-remote [user@host] [--no-build] [--credentials] [--port=N]; remote-logs / remote-status / remote-restart [user@host].
